method: MAWA supplied as the word Mawa, using approved voice C reference

heard_segments.2: You have three exciting destinations, the Australian Mathematics Competition, Marwa's Problem Solving Program, and Rossmoyne's Honours Mathematics Program. Each opens a different door into maths.
heard_segments.6: Marwa, the Mathematical Association of Western Australia, began in 1958. Its Problem -Solving program dates from 1992. It develops careful reasoning and clear explanations. You'll learn to ask why an idea works.
